description: This file defines a Jetpack Compose UI component for an Android TV top navigation bar with focus management and accessibility features. It includes composable functions to render a focusable, pill-shaped navigation menu with an initial focus request, icons, and text labels.

classes.name: TopNavBar
classes.description: A Jetpack Compose function creating a horizontally centered navigation bar with focus management, containing icons and text labels for an Android TV interface.

classes.name: FocusablePill
classes.description: A composable for individual focusable navigation items with focus feedback, supporting both icon and text labels, designed for TV remote navigation.

methods.name: TopNavBar
methods.description: Builds the top navigation bar with focus behavior, including initial focus request and click handling.

methods.name: FocusablePill
methods.description: Creates an individual, focusable UI element with visual focus feedback, handling key events and click actions.
